(declare ->MetadataZeroRecord map->MetadataZeroRecord ->MetadataOneRecord map->MetadataOneRecord ->MetadataManyRecord map->MetadataManyRecord)
(defrecord MetadataZeroRecord [])
(defrecord MetadataOneRecord [x])
(defrecord MetadataManyRecord [x y z])
(assert (= [0 1 3] (mapv #(count (first (:arglists (meta %)))) [#'->MetadataZeroRecord #'->MetadataOneRecord #'->MetadataManyRecord])))
(assert (= [1 1 1] (mapv #(count (first (:arglists (meta %)))) [#'map->MetadataZeroRecord #'map->MetadataOneRecord #'map->MetadataManyRecord])))
(assert (= '([]) (:arglists (meta #'->MetadataZeroRecord))))
(assert (= '([x]) (:arglists (meta #'->MetadataOneRecord))))
(assert (= '([x y z]) (:arglists (meta #'->MetadataManyRecord))))
(assert (every? symbol? (first (:arglists (meta #'map->MetadataManyRecord)))))
(assert (= 'map->MetadataManyRecord (:name (meta #'map->MetadataManyRecord))))
(assert (= "user" (ns-name (:ns (meta #'map->MetadataManyRecord)))))
(assert (= "Factory function for user/MetadataManyRecord, taking a map of keywords to field values." (:doc (meta #'map->MetadataManyRecord))))
(assert (= "Positional factory function for user/MetadataManyRecord." (:doc (meta #'->MetadataManyRecord))))
(assert (= (select-keys (meta #'->MetadataManyRecord) [:file :line :column])
           (select-keys (meta #'map->MetadataManyRecord) [:file :line :column])))
(assert (string? (:file (meta #'map->MetadataManyRecord))))
(assert (pos? (:line (meta #'map->MetadataManyRecord))))
(assert (pos? (:column (meta #'map->MetadataManyRecord))))
(assert (identical? @#'map->MetadataManyRecord map->MetadataManyRecord))
(assert (= #'map->MetadataManyRecord #'map->MetadataManyRecord))
(assert (= (->MetadataZeroRecord) (map->MetadataZeroRecord {})))
(assert (= (->MetadataOneRecord 7) (map->MetadataOneRecord {:x 7})))
(assert (= (->MetadataManyRecord 1 2 3) (map->MetadataManyRecord {:x 1 :y 2 :z 3})))
(assert (= [nil nil nil] (mapv #(get (map->MetadataManyRecord {}) %) [:x :y :z])))
(assert (= 9 (:extra (map->MetadataManyRecord {:x 1 :extra 9}))))
(def saved-position ->MetadataManyRecord)
(def saved-map map->MetadataManyRecord)
(def saved-var #'map->MetadataManyRecord)
(def saved-metadata (meta #'map->MetadataManyRecord))
(defrecord MetadataManyRecord [x y z])
(assert (not (identical? saved-position ->MetadataManyRecord)))
(assert (not (identical? saved-map map->MetadataManyRecord)))
(assert (= 1 (count (first (:arglists saved-metadata)))))
(assert (= [1] (mapv count (:arglists (meta saved-var)))))
(assert (= [3] (mapv count (:arglists (meta #'->MetadataManyRecord)))))
(assert (= [1 2 3] (mapv #(get (saved-position 1 2 3) %) [:x :y :z])))
(assert (= [4 5 6] (mapv #(get (saved-map {:x 4 :y 5 :z 6}) %) [:x :y :z])))
(assert (= [7 8 9] (mapv #(get (@saved-var {:x 7 :y 8 :z 9}) %) [:x :y :z])))
true
